title: Chemical Drain Cleaners vs. Mechanical Clearing
description: A common myth is that pouring chemical drain openers down a sink is a safe and permanent fix for clogged branch drains. In reality, caustic chemical drain cleaners rely on exothermic reactions that generate intense heat, which can soften thin-wall plastic piping and degrade rubber seals. Furthermore, if the chemical fails to clear the blockage, it leaves standing acid or lye trapped in the pipe. This creates a severe chemical burn hazard for plumbers who must disassemble the trap later. Using mechanical drain augers or cable snakes remains the safer, more effective professional solution.
caption:
Chemical Drain Cleaners vs. Mechanical Clearing

A common myth is that pouring chemical drain openers down a sink is a safe and permanent fix for clogged branch drains. In reality, caustic chemical drain cleaners rely on exothermic reactions that generate intense heat, which can soften thin-wall plastic piping and degrade rubber seals. Furthermore, if the chemical fails to clear the blockage, it leaves standing acid or lye trapped in the pipe. This creates a severe chemical burn hazard for plumbers who must disassemble the trap later. Using mechanical drain augers or cable snakes remains the safer, more effective professional solution.
